principle.reason: A positioning, objective or fixed decision met by the delivered store as a whole. Nothing to draw on its own.

cross_cutting.reason: Applies to every surface through its audience, responsive, right to left and state fields, not as a surface of its own.

behaviour.reason: Business logic with no screen of its own. What the customer or the staff member sees is on a surface already inventoried.

native_admin.reason: Met on a standard WordPress or WooCommerce administration screen. The register contracts the standard administration and no bespoke administration interface is designed (sections G10 and G11).

machine_output.reason: Output read by machines: structured data, feeds, language tags and analytics events. No screen.

integration.reason: An integration or a back-end guarantee behind the interface. No screen.

data_model.reason: A stored entity. No screen of its own.

non_functional.reason: A quality, security or operations requirement. No screen.

process.reason: A definition-of-done rule for how work is accepted. No screen.

developer_operated.reason: The initial catalogue migration, performed once by the Developer. The client operates no import screen.

deliverable.reason: A document, a handover item or the interface design as a whole. PRE-03b is this inventory's reason for existing, not a surface in it.

per_pre_09.reason: ERP-dependent. Whether the row has a screen, and which, is decided in PRE-09. Nothing is drawn before it is approved.

provider_hosted.reason: Met in a provider's own interface, which is not ours to design.
